import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext

set_option autoImplicit false
universe u
open CategoryTheory TensorProduct
open scoped TensorProduct
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
noncomputable section
variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
variable {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F k]

def context_hOpen (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F)
    (i : Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionIndex C) :
    IsOpenImmersion
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (D.models.mapM (Sum.inl i)).toRingHom)) :=
  D.models.openImmersion i

def context_hmap (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F)
    (q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C) :
    Pic0FiniteStageTransitionModelComparison C D.models.L D.models.n D.models.m
      D.models.relation D.models.e D.models.M D.models.mapM q :=
  D.models.comparison q

def context_htheta (D : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext C F)
    (p : Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionIndex C) :
    Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionFamilyComparison
      C D.models.L D.models.n D.models.m D.models.relation D.models.M D.models.mapM D.Q
        D.triple.N p (D.triple.thetaN p) :=
  D.triple.comparison p

end
end AlgebraicGeometry
